headline: The shelf went honestly dry: shipped-work phantom gone from the never-dry ladder
lede: Slot b closed out with the factory quieter than it has been in weeks. DK fire oil landed from slot a mid-window, the QA mini shipped the BARD'S TALE raycast dungeon — and the only remaining "open gap" on a 93-title audit turned out to be a shipped feature wearing a malformed CLOSED marker. One harness PR later, idle-kick answers NONE for builder and QA alike: lanes now stop correctly instead of burning sessions on completed work.

notes.text: DONKEY KONG: oil-drum flame kills on contact, fireballs climb the sound ladders, hammer smashes them (#3796, slot a).
THE BARD'S TALE: raycast dungeon — coursed stone, caps, baseboard, vignette (#3808, QA mini).
#3813: parseGaps now declines the by-less CLOSED (#N) notation — the phantom KICK PINBALL 0 weak was shipped, pinned work; the shelf is honestly dry (idle-kick NONE).
Open with a fresh ladder anyway — today's queue refilled in minutes; the dry-shelf question #3791 waits on Jon until Nov 29.

look.text: Feel the arcade's fireball rule in DONKEY KONG
